dialog.3.de.3.n: When an adjective comes before a noun, -e / -en is added to the end
grammar.0.title: Clothes and their plurals
grammar.0.note: Schuhe is mostly used in the plural (as a pair): „Ich brauche Schuhe.“
grammar.1.intro: tragen: a → ä with du and er.
grammar.1.note: fahren, tragen, schlafen — a changes to ä (with du and er).
grammar.2.title: anziehen or tragen?
grammar.2.text: anziehen = the act of putting something on: „Ich ziehe eine Jacke an.“ — a separable verb, the small part an goes to the end. tragen = to be wearing: „Ich trage eine Jacke.“ In a question: „Was ziehst du an?“ = What will you wear?
quiz.6.why: The main part is in second place, an goes at the end.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “I'm putting on a jacket.”
